desc:
Welcome to Play as Baldi! This is a Baldis Basics and Education and Learning fangame which allows you to play as any of the characters to catch students! Play as a Student to get YTP which allows you to purchase skins or even new characters! Find wacky Badges across the map, and much MORE! There's over 30+ characters with their own unique ways of catching or distracting Students! Play and find out who you enjoy the most! idk why i wrote this as if it was a mobile game ad

Happy 8th Anniversary Baldi's Basics!

(Badges with "[X]" on them means they are no longer obtainable!)

Default Game Icon Created by KingOfRascals!

Baldi's Basics owned by Basically Games and created by Mystman12. This is a Fan game and not associated with the Basically Games Brand. If Mystman or anybody else on the Basically Games team wants me to modify anything about the game, reach out to me with one of my socials!
